title: Portal 2 Full Game (No Commentary) With Extended/hidden Dialogue
confidence_note: principles at game level, not frame-accurate timestamps

observations.observation: Layered facility: clean test chambers over ruined, overgrown old Aperture. Decay + faded signage tell the history.
Puzzle rooms alternate with atmospheric traversal corridors that let the world breathe.
Minimal UI; the environment (light, scale, framing) guides the player.
